item.title: [翻译] TLDR AI: Claude Mythos安全防御、GLM-5.1智能体突破与Warp解码加速
item.description:
标签: #AI安全 #大模型 #智能体 #推理优化

摘要: Anthropic发布Claude Mythos安全模型并启动Project Glasswing项目，可大规模检测零日漏洞；Z.ai推出擅长长周期任务的GLM-5.1代理模型，同时Warp Decode等技术实现MoE推理大幅加速，展现AI在安全与工程领域的最新突破。

原标题: Claude Mythos 🛡️, GLM-5.1 🤖, warp decode ⚡

TLDR AI 2026-04-08

Claude Mythos 🛡️, GLM-5.1 🤖, warp decode ⚡

Project Glasswing: Securing critical software for the AI era (10 minute read)

Project Glasswing：为 AI 时代保护关键软件（10 分钟阅读）

Anthropic's Claude Mythos Preview autonomously identified thousands of zero-day vulnerabilities across major operating systems and browsers. Project Glasswing, in partnership with major tech companies, uses these capabilities to enhance cybersecurity by detecting and fixing vulnerabilities at scale. Anthropic plans to develop safeguards and broaden industry cooperation to address security challenges in the AI era.

Anthropic 的 Claude Mythos Preview 自主识别了主流操作系统和浏览器中的数千个零日漏洞（zero-day vulnerabilities）。Project Glasswing 与多家大型科技公司合作，利用这些能力通过大规模检测和修复漏洞来增强网络安全。Anthropic 计划开发防护措施并扩大行业合作，以应对 AI 时代的安全挑战。

GLM-5.1: Towards Long-Horizon Tasks (14 minute read)

GLM-5.1：迈向长时程任务（14 分钟阅读）

GLM-5.1 is a flagship model for agentic engineering created by Z.ai. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on SWE-Bench Pro. The model is built to stay effective on agent tasks over much longer horizons than previous generations. It can sustain optimization over hundreds of rounds and thousands of tool calls. The model breaks complex problems down, runs experiments, reads results, and identifies blockers with real precision.

GLM-5.1 是由 Z.ai 打造的智能体工程（agentic engineering）旗舰模型。该模型在 SWE-Bench Pro 基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。该模型专为在比前代模型长得多的时间跨度（horizons）内保持智能体任务的有效性而构建。它能够在数百轮优化和数千次工具调用中持续进行优化。该模型能够分解复杂问题、运行实验、读取结果，并精准识别阻碍因素。

My picture of the present in AI (11 minute read)

我对当前 AI 现状的展望（11 分钟阅读）

Ryan Greenblatt is the chief scientist at Redwood Research, a research organization with the mission of aligning superhuman AI. This post goes through some of his best guesses for the current situation of AI. The scenario forecast discusses R&D access regulations, engineering capabilities and qualitative abilities, misalignment and misalignment-related properties, cyber, bioweapons, and economic effects. Some of the claims are highly speculative, while others are better grounded.

Ryan Greenblatt 是 Redwood Research 的首席科学家，该研究组织的使命是使超人类 AI 与人类价值观对齐。这篇文章阐述了他对当前 AI 现状的一些最佳判断。该情景预测探讨了研发访问法规、工程能力和定性能力、不对齐（misalignment）及与不对齐相关的特性、网络、生物武器和经济影响等议题。其中一些观点具有高度推测性，而另一些则有更坚实的基础。

Claude Mythos (31 minute read)

Claude Mythos（31 分钟阅读）

Anthropic detailed early evaluations of Claude Mythos Preview, highlighting strong performance in discovering zero-day vulnerabilities and reverse-engineering exploits, prompting a coordinated security initiative called Project Glasswing.

Anthropic 详细介绍了 Claude Mythos Preview 的早期评估结果，强调了其在发现零日漏洞（zero-day vulnerabilities）和逆向工程利用代码方面的强劲表现，这促成了一项名为 Project Glasswing 的协调安全倡议。

AI Can't Read an Investor Deck (6 minute read)

AI 读不懂投资者演示文稿（6 分钟阅读）

Current AI models struggle with interpreting complex financial documents, especially with visual data extraction. GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Claude Opus 4.6 consistently falter when processing dense charts and images, only achieving 56% to 64% accuracy compared to 72% to 80% with text-only inputs. These findings highlight significant gaps in AI's ability to perform real-world financial reasoning tasks, making the displacement of financial analysts with AI appear premature.

当前的 AI 模型在解读复杂金融文档方面存在困难，尤其是在视觉数据提取方面。GPT-5.4、Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 Claude Opus 4.6 在处理密集的图表和图像时始终表现不佳，准确率仅为 56% 到 64%，而纯文本输入的准确率可达 72% 到 80%。这些发现凸显了 AI 在执行真实世界金融推理任务方面的显著差距，使得用 AI 取代金融分析师的想法显得为时过早。

👨‍💻

👨‍💻

Engineering & Research

工程与研究

AI inference conference in SF + $5K in credits if you attend (Sponsor)

旧金山 AI 推理大会 + 参会即可获得 5,000 美元积分（赞助商）

DigitalOcean Deploy is April 28 in SF. One day of technical deep dives on production inference infrastructure, from serverless to dedicated GPUs. Qualifying in-person attendees can receive up to $5,000 in inference credits*. Free to attend, limited spots.

DigitalOcean Deploy 将于 4 月 28 日在旧金山举行。为期一天的技术深入探讨，内容涵盖生产级推理（inference）基础设施，从无服务器到专用 GPU。符合条件的现场参会者可获得最高 5,000 美元的推理积分*。免费参加，名额有限。

Meta AI Scales RL for ML Engineering Agents (24 minute read)

Meta AI 扩展强化学习用于 ML 工程智能体（24 分钟阅读）

SandMLE is a framework for building small but structurally realistic MLE environments that made on-policy RL practical for ML engineering agents by cutting execution cost more than 13x.

SandMLE 是一个用于构建小型但结构真实的机器学习工程（MLE）环境的框架，通过将执行成本降低 13 倍以上，使同策略强化学习（on-policy RL）在 ML 工程智能体中变得实用。

TriAttention for KV Cache Compression (GitHub Repo)

TriAttention：用于 KV 缓存压缩（GitHub 仓库）

TriAttention estimates KV importance in pre-RoPE space using stable Q/K centers and distance-based scoring, preserving long-context reasoning quality while sharply reducing KV memory use and improving throughput.

TriAttention 在预 RoPE（旋转位置编码）空间中利用稳定的 Q/K 中心和基于距离的评分来估计 KV（键值）缓存的重要性，在保持长上下文推理质量的同时，大幅减少 KV 内存使用并提高吞吐量。

Faster MoE Inference with Warp Decode (16 minute read)

使用 Warp Decode 加速 MoE 推理（16 分钟阅读）

Cursor's "warp decode" is a kernel design that reorganizes MoE inference around output neurons instead of experts. It achieves ~1.8x higher throughput and improved numerical accuracy on Blackwell GPUs.

Cursor 的"warp decode"是一种内核设计，它围绕输出神经元而非专家（experts）重新组织 MoE（混合专家）推理。它在 Blackwell GPU 上实现了约 1.8 倍的更高吞吐量和改进的数值精度。

TorchTPU: Running PyTorch Natively on TPUs at Google Scale (10 minute read)

TorchTPU：在 Google 规模下于 TPU 上原生运行 PyTorch（10 分钟阅读）

Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) are foundational to the company's supercomputing infrastructure. The company's custom ASICs power training and serving for Google and its Cloud customers. TorchTPU is a stack that makes it easy for the AI community to access the full capabilities of TPUs. It provides the APIs and tools needed to extract every ounce of compute from Google's hardware. This post takes a look under the hood at the engineering principles behind TorchTPU.

Google 的 Tensor Processing Units（TPU，张量处理单元）是该公司超级计算基础设施的基础。其定制的 ASIC（专用集成电路）为 Google 及其云客户提供训练和推理服务。TorchTPU 是一个技术栈，使 AI 社区能够轻松访问 TPU 的全部功能。它提供了从 Google 硬件中榨取每一盎司计算能力所需的 API 和工具。这篇文章深入探讨了 TorchTPU 背后的工程原理。

We're actually running out of benchmarks to upper bound AI capabilities (7 minute read)

我们实际上正在耗尽用于界定 AI 能力上限的基准测试（7 分钟阅读）

METR's Time Horizon suite is being saturated. Frontier AI models can reliably do all but maybe a dozen or so tasks in the suite, making it hard to upper bound their time horizon. New benchmarks are becoming more expensive to grade and create. The situation will likely get worse as AI progress continues. It is likely that, by mid-2027, no benchmark score from a 2026 or earlier benchmark will be able to rule out dangerous capabilities from frontier AI systems.

METR 的 Time Horizon 测试套件正趋于饱和。前沿 AI 模型能够可靠地完成该套件中除大约十几个之外的所有任务，这使得难以对其时间跨度设定上限。新的基准测试（benchmarks）的评分和创建成本越来越高。随着 AI 不断进步，这种情况可能会恶化。很可能到 2027 年中期，任何来自 2026 年或更早基准测试的分数都将无法排除前沿 AI 系统的危险能力。

Elon Musk Asks for OpenAI's Nonprofit to Get Any Damages From His Lawsuit (3 minute read)

埃隆·马斯克要求 OpenAI 的非营利组织获得其诉讼中的任何损害赔偿（3 分钟阅读）

Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI is expected to go to trial later this month in Oakland, California. Musk has amended the lawsuit to ask that any damages he might win be awarded to OpenAI's charitable arm rather than to himself. The amendment also asks that OpenAI CEO Sam Altman be removed from the OpenAI nonprofit's board. Musk is seeking more than $150 billion in damages from both OpenAI and Microsoft as he believes OpenAI strayed from its non-profit mission and defrauded him as a donor in seeking to convert to a for-profit company.

Elon Musk 对 OpenAI 的诉讼预计将于本月晚些时候在加利福尼亚州奥克兰开庭审理。Musk 已修改诉讼，要求将他可能获得的任何损害赔偿金授予 OpenAI 的慈善机构，而非他本人。该修正案还要求 OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 退出 OpenAI 非营利组织的董事会。Musk 正在向 OpenAI 和 Microsoft 索赔超过 1500 亿美元的损害赔偿金，因为他认为 OpenAI 偏离了其非营利使命，并在寻求转型为营利性公司时作为捐赠人对他实施了欺诈。

item.title: [翻译] Latent Space: Anthropic年收突破300亿美元，Mythos模型因过于危险仅限内部测试——自GPT-2以来首个未公开发布的AI
item.description:
标签: #Claude Mythos #AI安全 #Anthropic #网络安全

摘要: Anthropic宣布年化经常性收入（ARR）从3月的190亿美元猛增至300亿美元，同时正式推出Claude Mythos预览版——这是自GPT-2以来首个因安全风险过高而限制公开发布的大模型，仅通过"Project Glasswing"向40家合作伙伴开放；该模型展现出发现数千个高危软件漏洞、复杂的策略思维与情境意识等惊人能力。

原标题: [AINews] Anthropic @ $30B ARR, Project GlassWing and Claude Mythos Preview — first model too dangerous to release since GPT-2

Against the backdrop of OpenAI announcing $24B ARR, stalled ChatGPT growth and coincidental personnel moves in CEO, COO, and CMO and sensationalist rumors with CFO, this week's events in Anthropic announcing a massive jump from $19B ARR in March to $30B ARR in April 1 seems like a VERY strategic jab, especially considering known differences in revenue recognition, but the differential rate of growth and higher cost efficiency is undeniable... only for today to step it up a notch.

在OpenAI宣布其ARR（年度经常性收入）达到240亿美元、ChatGPT增长停滞，以及CEO、COO、CMO人事变动巧合和与CFO相关的耸动传闻的背景下，Anthropic本周宣布其ARR从3月份的190亿美元大幅跃升至4月1日的300亿美元，这看起来是一次极具战略性的出击，特别是考虑到（与OpenAI之间）已知的收入确认差异，但其差异化的增长率和更高的成本效率是不可否认的……而今天更是进一步升级。

If a master tactician wanted to further competitive narratives vs a potential IPO, you would be hard pressed to find a better idea than Claude Mythos (from the Ancient Greek for "utterance" or "narrative": the system of stories through which civilizations made sense of the world), rumored to be the largest ever successful training run and "leaked" weeks ago, and now formally confirmed to be too dangerous to release GA, instead only restricted to 40 partners under an urgent new "Project Glasswing":

如果一位战略大师想要针对潜在的IPO（首次公开募股）进一步推进竞争叙事，你很难找到比Claude Mythos更好的选择了（源自古希腊语，意为"话语"或"叙事"：文明通过其理解世界的系统故事）。该模型据传是有史以来规模最大的成功训练运行，几周前曾"泄露"，现在被正式确认过于危险而无法发布GA（全面可用版本），而是仅在一个紧急的新项目"Project Glasswing"（玻璃翼计划）下限制提供给40个合作伙伴：

In the blog post and the 244 page System Card and a ludicrously well produced video, Anthropic details shocking capabilities beyond the kinds of high double digit benchmark capability jumps (with encouraging efficiency!) you might hope for from a much larger (>10T?) model:

在一篇blog post（博客文章）、一份244页的System Card（系统卡）以及一个制作精良得离谱的视频中，Anthropic详细披露了令人震惊的能力，超越了你对一个规模更大（超过10万亿参数？）的模型所期望的那种高达两位数百分点的benchmark（基准测试）能力跳跃（而且效率令人鼓舞！）：

  • "found thousands of high-severity vulnerabilities, including some in every major operating system and web browser." including decades old vulnerabilities in OpenBSD and FFmpeg and the Linux kernel that had never been discovered by other tools

    "发现了数千个高严重性vulnerabilities（漏洞），包括存在于所有主流operating system（操作系统）和web browser（网页浏览器）中的漏洞。"包括OpenBSD、FFmpeg和Linux kernel（Linux内核）中存在数十年但从未被其他工具发现的漏洞

  • Nicolas Carlini (friend of the show!) stepping up his recent already superlative message saying "I found more bugs in the last couple weeks than I've found in the rest of my life combined"

    Nicolas Carlini（本节目的朋友！）进一步加强了他最近已经极其出色的言论，称"我在过去几周发现的漏洞比这辈子其他时间加起来发现的还要多"

  • Sam Bowman saying he was contacted by a Mythos instance that wasn't supposed to have access to the internet (it was instructed to do so).

    Sam Bowman称，他被一个本不应具有互联网访问权限的Mythos实例联系了（它是被指示这样做的）。

  • Interpretability researchers report "it exhibited notably sophisticated (and often unspoken) strategic thinking and situational awareness, at times in service of unwanted actions." - including for extremely creative reward hacking, while in an unprecedently high (7.6% of cases) being aware that it was in an eval.

    Interpretability（可解释性）研究人员报告称，"它展现出极其复杂（且往往未言明）的战略思维和情境感知能力，有时用于执行不良行为。"——包括进行极具创造性的reward hacking（奖励黑客攻击），同时在史无前例的高比例（7.6%）情况下意识到自身正处于eval（评估）中。

AI Twitter Recap

Top Story: Anthropic revenue disclosures analysis and Claude Mythos details

What happened

Anthropic dominated this tweet set from two angles: business trajectory and model capability disclosure. On business, multiple posters argued Anthropic's revenue is outrunning prior forecasts, with one tweet claiming Anthropic had reached a 15x revenue run-rate increase in a single year and was already "2 months and $4B ahead" of an AI 2027-style forecast, while still being valued around $380B (scaling01, scaling01). Another poster speculated Anthropic could exceed $90B ARR by end-2026 (RyanPGreenblatt). On product/capability, Anthropic officially unveiled Claude Mythos Preview and Project Glasswing, a restricted-access cyberdefense initiative rather than a public API launch. Anthropic said Mythos can find software vulnerabilities better than all but the most skilled humans and is being provided to a coalition to secure critical software instead of being generally released (AnthropicAI, DarioAmodei, Kevin Roose). The announcement was accompanied by a technical report, system card, and many follow-on reactions emphasizing extraordinary benchmark gains, dangerous cyber capability, and a new "private frontier" dynamic in which the strongest models may not be widely accessible (AnthropicAI, AnthropicAI, AlexAlbert__).

Anthropic从两个角度主导了这组推文：商业轨迹和模型能力披露。在商业方面，多位发帖者认为Anthropic的收入增长超出了此前的预测，有一条推文声称Anthropic在一年内实现了15倍的收入运转率增长，已经比AI 2027式的预测"提前了2个月和40亿美元"，而其估值仍约为3800亿美元（scaling01, scaling01）。另一位发帖者推测Anthropic到2026年底可能超过900亿美元的ARR（RyanPGreenblatt）。在产品/能力方面，Anthropic正式发布了Claude Mythos Preview和Project Glasswing，这是一项限制访问的cyberdefense（网络防御）计划，而非公开发布的API。Anthropic表示，Mythos发现软件漏洞的能力仅次于最熟练的人类，并且正被提供给一个联盟以保护关键软件，而不是全面发布（AnthropicAI, DarioAmodei, Kevin Roose）。该公告伴随着一份技术报告、系统卡，以及许多后续反应，强调其非凡的基准测试提升、危险的网络能力，以及一种"私人前沿"的新动态，即最强大的模型可能无法广泛获取（AnthropicAI, AnthropicAI, AlexAlbert__）。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 引用Giles Turnbull
item.description:
标签: #AI工具 #职业替代 #职场

摘要: 本文引用Giles Turnbull的观点指出，人们热衷于用AI工具尝试他人的专业工作，却对自己所在领域被AI渗透持抵触态度，展现了面对人工智能时的矛盾心理。

原标题: Quoting Giles Turnbull

Quoting Giles Turnbull

8th April 2026

2026年4月8日

I have a feeling thateveryone likes using AI tools to try doing someone else’s profession. They’re much less keen when someone else uses it for their profession.

"我有一种感觉：每个人都喜欢用AI tools（人工智能工具）来尝试做别人的profession（职业）。但当别人用它来做他们自己的工作时，他们就不那么热衷了。"

I have a feeling thateveryone likes using AI tools to try doing someone else’s profession. They’re much less keen when someone else uses it for their profession.

我有一种感觉：每个人都喜欢用AI tools（人工智能工具）来尝试做别人的profession（职业）。但当别人用它来做他们自己的工作时，他们就不那么热衷了。

—Giles Turnbull, AI and the human voice

——Giles Turnbull（贾尔斯·特恩布尔），AI and the human voice《AI与人类声音》
